# kubesense_kong_control_plane (Resource)

A Kong gateway integration. KubeSense checks the credentials when the integration is created and refuses ones that fail or belong to another account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Kong Konnect: one integration per control plane.
resource "kubesense_kong_control_plane" "konnect" {
  org_id           = "acme"
  mode             = "konnect"
  base_url         = "https://us.api.konghq.com"
  control_plane_id = "6c1f0a3e-8d2b-4e4f-9a7c-1b3d5f7e9a21"
  bearer_token     = var.konnect_token
}

# A self-hosted gateway, reached through its Admin API.
resource "kubesense_kong_control_plane" "self_hosted" {
  org_id        = "acme-onprem"
  mode          = "self_hosted"
  base_url      = "https://kong-admin.example.com:8444"
  admin_api_key = var.kong_admin_api_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_id` (String) Organization id. Changing it creates a new integration.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether collection runs. false pauses it and keeps credentials and settings.
- `admin_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Admin API key, for mode = self_hosted. Write-only on the server, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected, and it is not set on import.
- `base_url` (String) Admin API base URL.
- `bearer_token` (String, Sensitive) Konnect personal access token, for mode = konnect. Write-only on the server, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected, and it is not set on import.
- `control_plane_id` (String) Konnect control plane UUID, for mode = konnect. It identifies the integration, so changing it creates a new one.
- `mode` (String) konnect (Kong Konnect) or self_hosted.
- `resource_types` (Attributes Map) Resource types to collect, keyed by resource type (see Settings → Integrations for the names). When set, Terraform owns collection: types enabled in the UI but not listed here are switched off on the next apply. When omitted, collection is left to the UI. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resource_types))

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) Name shown in the UI: the account name the credentials resolved to.
- `id` (String) Integration id (the API's kuid).
- `status` (String) pending, healthy, error, paused or deleting.

<a id="nestedatt--resource_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resource_types`

Required:

- `collect` (Boolean) Collect inventory.
- `metric_enabled` (Boolean) Collect metrics.

Optional:

- `metric_extras` (Set of String) Extra metric names beyond the tier.
- `metric_tier` (String) core (the default) or expanded.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The id is the integration's kuid, shown in Settings → Integrations. Tokens
# and keys are not imported; set them in the configuration.
terraform import kubesense_kong_control_plane.konnect 8e4b1d2f-6a3c-4b7e-9d5f-2c8a0e1b7f63
```
